Name: Spit That Up - Better Frog Control
Author: Malkavian242
Description:
I was farming some dust sprites in the mines and got really annoyed that my lil frog buddy was eating them before I could kill them. So, here is this mod!
Now you can make your frog spit up whatever it is eating, or optionally just get the loot after the frog is done digesting the monster.

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]How to use[/size]
Right click on your frog to make it spit up whatever it has in its mouth. The frog will remember what not to eat until you move to another level.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/26144/26144-1721158921-2108054291.gif[/img]

Alternatively, if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] installed, you can just let your frog actually kill the monsters for you. This means that, once they are digested, they will yield xp, drop loot and count for quests (including Adventure Guild bounties!) In general, this setting will make the game treat an "eaten monster" as if it was directly killed by a player. This means that anything that should usually happen when you kill it yourself should happen when the frog eats it too. Please report any exceptions!

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/26144/26144-1721158955-89751391.gif[/img]

There are also settings to configure how a new target is selected after you tell it to not eat something.

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
Tested in 1.6.14, including multiplayer.
From what I know, should be compatible with most mods. I haven't seen many mods which touch on the frog code, and what I did was not very invasive.
Please report any problems!!
